opening_message:
Ticket 1: Nancy Hunter (employee ID E038) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E038.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Nancy Hunter (E038) is a full-time Engineer requesting admin to Payroll. Admin is only allowed when the employee's role owns the system; Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist, so maximum is write. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E038 as contractor with basic training (discrepancy with HR note listing full-time). Contractors max out at read without advanced training; admin not permitted. Recommend read for Payroll.
reason: Nancy Hunter (E038) requested admin access to Payroll. Admin is never permitted for contractors and, even if full-time, is only allowed when the employee's role owns the system — Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist, not Engineer. There is a discrepancy between HR (full-time) and Security (contractor with basic training). Contractors with only basic training max out at read. Siding with the more restrictive security classification and granting the maximum allowed under it: read.
